source_problem: DDD Theorem 4.3: Positive Linear 3-Disjoint NAE-(2,3)-SAT-E3 with exactly one 2-clause per variable

target_problem.question: alternative model preserving protected variables and flipping pivot

mechanisms: PIX equal controls = one-pair-relaxed binary interface
fanout<=2 source ternary layers give polynomially constructible base model
bounded-degree PIX-XOR signal tree distributes one pivot
pivot flip changes every activation PIX from equal-control to opposite-control mode
conclusions: single-pivot protected repair existence is NP-complete in the target class
escape-selector existence is NP-complete there by the exact mask-selector completeness theorem
fanout 3 is not a selector-synthesis polynomial island

active_gate.target: poly witness-preserving quotient of a shared pivot-controlled family of activated parity interfaces
